university.name: St Mary's University, Twickenham
university.summary: St Mary's University has its campus on Waldegrave Road, Strawberry Hill, Twickenham, London. It publishes a Pakistan country page, English language requirements by level of study, and a list of international scholarships and fee discounts.

courses.title: International Business Management
courses.overview: A one-year full-time master's in business management with core modules in ethical leadership, international strategy, international finance economics and people management, completed with an independent project, plus optional modules.
courses.academic_requirements: Expected to have at least a second class honours degree from a UK or overseas university (or equivalent). Previous degree listed as 2:2.
courses.english_requirements: St Mary's English language page: postgraduate degrees require IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with no less than 6.0 in any section; PTE Academic 61 overall with no less than 59 in any component; TOEFL iBT 88 overall (reading 20, listening 19, speaking 21, writing 20). Tests must be no more than two years old. Duolingo is not mentioned on that page.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan country page: a Bachelor degree plus a Master's degree from a recognised institution. UK 2:2 equals Pakistan grade point average 2.6 (4.0 scale) or 65%; UK 2:1 equals 2.8 or 70%.
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published: GBP 18,990 is shown under the September 2026 and January 2027 headings; no fee shown for September 2027. Page heading says MSc while the page title says MA. Module list has no academic year stated and applies to students with a previous business degree. TOEFL scores for tests taken after January 2026 are on a 1 to 6 scale on the English page and are not recorded here.

courses.title: International Finance and Accounting
courses.overview: A one-year full-time master's whose listed core modules cover management accounting, financial accounting, investment markets, economics and international finance, international strategy and an independent project.
highlights: Core: Investment Markets and Investment Decision Making
courses.academic_requirements: Expected to have at least a second class honours degree from a UK or overseas university (or equivalent). Previous degree listed as 2:2.
courses.english_requirements: St Mary's English language page: postgraduate degrees require IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with no less than 6.0 in any section; PTE Academic 61 overall with no less than 59 in any component; TOEFL iBT 88 overall (reading 20, listening 19, speaking 21, writing 20). Tests must be no more than two years old. Duolingo is not mentioned on that page.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan country page: a Bachelor degree plus a Master's degree from a recognised institution. UK 2:2 equals Pakistan grade point average 2.6 (4.0 scale) or 65%; UK 2:1 equals 2.8 or 70%.
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published: GBP 18,990 is shown under the January 2027 and September 2026 headings; no fee shown for September 2027. Module list has no academic year stated.

courses.title: Psychology
courses.overview: A three-year undergraduate psychology degree. First year modules listed include core introductions to social and developmental psychology and to cognitive and biological psychology, with research methods and statistics.
highlights: Core: Introduction to Social and Developmental Psychology
Core: Introduction to Cognitive and Biological Psychology
Research Methods and Statistics 1 and 2 (core optional)
courses.academic_requirements: Standard offer 120 UCAS points; contextual offer 96 UCAS points (entries 2026 to 2028). The international requirements section of the course page lists no content.
courses.english_requirements: St Mary's English language page: undergraduate degrees require IELTS Academic 6.0 overall with no less than 5.5 in any section; PTE Academic 59 overall and in each skill; TOEFL iBT 80 overall (reading 18, listening 17, speaking 20, writing 17). Tests must be no more than two years old. Duolingo is not mentioned on that page.
courses.pakistan_entry_note: Pakistan country page routes: Higher Secondary Certificate plus two years of a Bachelor degree, or HSC plus one year of a 4-year Bachelor degree. Tariff: 128 points at 3.0/4.0 or 75%; 112 to 120 points at 2.8/4.0 or 70%; 96 to 104 points at 2.6/4.0 or 65%.
courses.notes: Target year fee not yet published: GBP 17,445 is the September 2026 fee and the page states September 2027 fees will be published shortly. Course page shows start September 2026 only, so no intake label recorded. Year 1 module grouping is inferred from the page layout. Pakistan route does not map to a single pk_route value, so pk fields left null.

courses.title: Business Management and Marketing
courses.overview: A three-year undergraduate degree combining business management and marketing. Listed first year modules cover marketing, organisational behaviour, digital business, financial management and professional skills.
courses.academic_requirements: Standard offer 112 UCAS points; contextual offer 96 UCAS points (entries 2026 to 2028). The international requirements section of the course page lists no content.
courses.english_requirements: St Mary's English language page: undergraduate degrees require IELTS Academic 6.0 overall with no less than 5.5 in any section; PTE Academic 59 overall and in each skill; TOEFL iBT 80 overall (reading 18, listening 17, speaking 20, writing 17). Tests must be no more than two years old. Duolingo is not mentioned on that page.

scholarships.name: Country Scholarship (Undergraduate)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 1,500 per year tuition fee discount for all years of study (GBP 1,000 for listed health and sport subjects)
scholarships.summary: Automatic annual fee discount for offer-holders ordinarily resident in listed countries receiving official development assistance, which includes Pakistan.
scholarships.criteria_text: Offer-holder ordinarily resident in a listed country; overseas fee payer; full-time on campus. Cannot be held with the Excellence Scholarship.
scholarships.notes: Terms published for September 2026 and January 2027 entry; 2027/28 terms not yet seen. Reduced rate applies to Nutrition, Psychology, Sports Science and related subjects, so Psychology would receive GBP 1,000.

scholarships.name: Country Scholarship (Postgraduate)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 1,500 tuition fee discount for most postgraduate courses (GBP 1,000 for listed subjects, the MRes in Sport, Health and Applied Science, and PGCE courses without a UK Government bursary)
scholarships.summary: Automatic fee discount for postgraduate offer-holders ordinarily resident in listed countries receiving official development assistance, which includes Pakistan.
scholarships.criteria_text: Offer-holder ordinarily resident in a listed country; overseas fee payer; full-time on campus. Awards are for the first year only on courses longer than one year. Cannot be held with the Excellence Scholarship.
scholarships.notes: Terms published for September 2026 and January 2027 entry; 2027/28 terms not yet seen.

scholarships.name: Excellence Scholarship (Undergraduate)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 4,000 per year tuition fee discount for all years of study, excluding reduced-fee placement years (GBP 3,000 for listed health and sport subjects)
scholarships.summary: Automatic annual fee discount for overseas fee-paying offer-holders, assessed on prior academic achievement and country of domicile.
scholarships.criteria_text: Assessed on prior academic achievement and country of domicile; overseas fee payer; full-time on campus. Cannot be held with the Country Scholarship.
scholarships.notes: The page does not say which domicile countries qualify, so eligibility for Pakistan is not confirmed. Terms published for September 2026 and January 2027 entry; 2027/28 terms not yet seen.

scholarships.name: Excellence Scholarship (Postgraduate)
scholarships.value_text: GBP 4,000 tuition fee discount, first year only, on most courses (GBP 2,000 for listed health and sport subjects)
scholarships.summary: Automatic fee discount for overseas fee-paying postgraduate offer-holders, assessed on prior academic achievement and country of domicile.
scholarships.criteria_text: Assessed on prior academic achievement and country of domicile; overseas fee payer; full-time on campus. Cannot be held with the Country Scholarship.
scholarships.notes: The page does not say which domicile countries qualify, so eligibility for Pakistan is not confirmed. The page is internally inconsistent about research degrees: a general line says awards are not available for research, MPhil and PhD courses, yet MPhil and PhD appear at GBP 2,000. Terms published for September 2026 and January 2027 entry.

scholarships.name: MBA Scholarship
scholarships.value_text: GBP 2,500 tuition fee discount for all eligible MBA applicants, or GBP 4,000 for a limited number with higher academic achievement
scholarships.summary: Automatic fee discount for full-time MBA offer-holders who pay international fees.
scholarships.criteria_text: Full-time MBA applicants paying international fees; offer required.
scholarships.notes: Terms published for September 2026 and January 2027 entry; 2027/28 terms not yet seen. The MBA course page was not opened, so no MBA course row is included.
